description: This file defines a data transfer object class ClaimEventSearchFilterParams used for filtering claim event search parameters in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties for name, status, and id, along with their respective getters and setters. It also specifies allowed sort fields and initializes the default sort field in the constructor.

classes.name: ClaimEventSearchFilterParams
classes.description: Data transfer object for filtering claim event search results, including properties name, status, and id, with validation of allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object with default sort field 'claimEvent.name'.
